q2: SELECT DISTINCT X.A AS A FROM R AS X
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Y.A AS A FROM R AS X, R AS Y WHERE X.A = Y.A
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT X.A AS A FROM R AS X
explanation: Q1 attempts to join the table R with itself on the attribute A and then select distinct values of A. Q2 simply selects distinct values of A from the table R. The difference arises because Q1's join condition (X.A = Y.A) might introduce duplicate values of A in the result set if there are multiple rows in R with the same value of A, while Q2 will only return each unique value of A once.
counterexample_dsp: The test data should have at least two rows with the same value of A to demonstrate the difference between Q1 and Q2. Q1 will return this duplicate value twice in the result set, while Q2 will return it only once.
